sentences.text: Our original array is 8, 1, 6, 3, 2, 2, 4, 10, 9, 11, minus 1 and 0.
First, put all the values into a set.
So we are left with 11 unique values.
Now let's dry run the idea.
Do we have 7 in the set?
0 is already present in the set.
That means 1 is somewhere in the middle of a sequence.
And that's the whole dry run.
We did not walk again from 1 or 3 or 2 or 4 or 10 or 9 or 11 or 0.
Because all of them already had a number just before them.
We only walked from real starting points.
And the longest sequence we found has length 6.
Now the code will make much more sense.
